tokens.npc_dota_hero_mirana_bio: Born to a royal family, a blood princess next in line for the Solar Throne, Mirana willingly surrendered any claim to mundane land or titles when she dedicated herself completely to the service of Selemene, Goddess of the Moon. Known ever since as Princess of the Moon, Mirana prowls the sacred Nightsilver Woods searching for any who would dare poach the sacred luminous lotus from the silvery pools of the Goddess's preserve. Riding on her enormous feline familiar, she is poised, proud and fearless, attuned to the phases of the moon and the wheeling of the greater constellations. Her bow, tipped with sharp shards of lunar ore, draws on the moon's power to charge its arrows of light.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_mirana_hype: As she takes aim from a distance with her deadly arrow, Mirana must always be ready to leap into battle. Able to shield her allies from the eyes of her enemies, she ensures that her team is always on the prowl.

fields.value:
* This ability has two main components:
** All meteors do not affect the following units:
*** {{M|Hidden}} units.
*** {{M|Invisible}} units.
*** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
*** {{M|Untargetable}} units.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px|1]] {{Symbol|Projectile|Impact}}
*** The first meteors have the following properties:
**** Have a {{#var:Starstorm value2}}-second effect delay.
**** Does not affect the following units:
***** {{M|Fogged}} units.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px|2]] {{Symbol|Projectile|Impact}}
*** Procs the secondary meteor component {{#var:Starstorm type1 value2}} seconds after cast.
**** The {{M|projectiles}} starts falling, with a {{#var:Starstorm value2}}-second effect delay as well.
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}

**** Hence, this now affects the following things:
***** Affects {{M|fogged}} units.
***** Chooses a new target upon the set target's {{M|death}}.

fields.value: Fires a long-range arrow that stuns and damages the first enemy unit it impacts.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: The Sacred Arrow instant kills the first non-ancient creep unit it hits.

fields.name: interacts
mechanics
fields.value:
* This ability has four main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{hi|Mirana}} {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}} [[File:Dota2 PtoP.png|21px]] {{Symbol|Projectile|Base}} [[File:Dota2 Pto.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 toP.png|21px]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|P|21px]]
*** The [[projectile]] starts traveling {{#var:Sacred Arrow basic2}}-distance in front of Mirana, and travels until the max arrow distance.
*** Hence, it neither searches for units behind the projectile nor affects enemy units within 50-distance in front of Mirana.
*** {{Symbol|Projectile|Travel}}
**** Can affect enemy units up to {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{#expr:{{#var:Sacred Arrow value1}}+{{#var:Sacred Arrow value3}}}}-distance away.
**** {{Symbol|Vision|Flying}}
***** A non-lingering {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} 400-radius [[flying vision]] around the projectile while it is traveling.
*** The values increases per {{#expr:{{#var:Sacred Arrow type1 value1}}/(({{#var:Sacred Arrow type1 value1}}/{{#var:Sacred Arrow basic1}})/{{G|tick rate}}) round0}}-distance traveled per {{M|server tick}}, and reaches max power after traveling {{#expr:{{#var:Sacred Arrow type1 value1}}/{{#var:Sacred Arrow basic1}} round2}} seconds as follows:
**** {{Symbol|a|Up}}
***** Increases the total {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} bonus by {{#expr:{{#var:Sacred Arrow type1 value1}}/({{#var:Sacred Arrow type1 value2}}/{{G|tick rate}}) round3}} per server tick.
***** Increases the total {{M|stun}} duration by {{calc|v1/(({{#var:Sacred Arrow value2}}/{{#var:Sacred Arrow basic1}})/{{G|tick rate}}) round4|v1={{#var:Sacred Arrow type1 value3}}}} seconds per server tick.
*** The arrow does not affect the following units:
**** {{M|Couriers}}
**** {{M|Hidden}} units.
**** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Projectile|Impact}}
*** The ability effects are applied as follows upon projectile impact: 
***# The {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
***#* Considers enemy {{M|clones}}, {{M|strong illusions}} and {{M|creep-heroes}} as heroes, {{M|illusion}} as creeps.
***#* {{M|Instant kill}} creeps utilizing the {{M|HP Removal}} mechanic.
***# {{Symbol|Stun}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|modifier_[[stun]]ned}}
***#* {{Symbol|fx|v}}
***#** The impact stun duration displayed above the affected enemy unit is [[wikipedia:Floor and ceiling functions|truncated]], visible ally-only.
***# {{Symbol|Vision|Flying}}
***#* A 3-second {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} 400-radius [[flying vision]] centered on the affected enemy unit upon arrow impact.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-3.png|3|21px]]
*** {{cf|talnotes}} The {{ValueColor||multishot|25tal}} {{M|talent|t=t4r}} launches {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Sacred Arrow value3 tal}}-{{#var:Sacred Arrow value3}}}}|25tal}} secondary arrows, {{ValueColor||{{#var:Sacred Arrow type3 value1}}|25tal}} angled to the left and right of the primary arrow.
**** Although all arrows overlap in front of Mirana, they do not hit the same target.
**** Each arrow can only can affect the same enemy units once per cast.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-4.png|4|21px]]
*** {{cf|aghnotes}} The primary Sacred Arrow now releases two types of meteors of the corresponding {{A|Mirana|Starstorm}} ability level:
**** The meteors have the following properties:
***** Works independently of Starstorm's {{M|cooldown}}, and does not cost {{M|mana}}.
***** Does not proc {{M|on-cast effects}}.
**** {{Symbol|Projectile|Travel}}
***** While traveling, the primary arrow calls upon first meteors onto all enemy units within its search radius.
**** {{Symbol|Projectile|Impact}}
***** Upon arrow impact, the arrow calls another single-target secondary meteor onto the debuff-affected enemy unit. The {{M|spell damage}} is defined as:
****** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|2ndDmg {{=}} Σ[[Mirana#Starstorm|Starstorm]]Dmg × {{#var:Sacred Arrow type3 value3 agh}}}}
***** The {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}} only upgrades the primary arrow.

fields.name: buff1text
fields.value: Moonlight Shadow: Invisible. Attacking temporarily removes invisibility.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* Grants all affected allied heroes the following ability effects:
** Considers {{M|clones}} as heroes, {{M|illusions}}, {{M|creep-heroes}} and {{A|Monkey King|Wukong's Command|text=Wukong's Command Soldiers}} as creeps.
** {{Symbol|Invisible}}
*** The affected unit will keep turning [[invisible]] for the entire duration.
*** During the {{M|fade delay}}, the affected unit can still attack and cast abilities.
*** Grants bonus {{M|movement speed}} while fully invisible.
*** Does not grant {{M|phase movement}}.
*** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|moonlight_shadow}}
**** Sources with fade delays utilize the {{Code|modifier_invisible}} buff.
**** Buff sources of the same modifier do not stack, the longer duration buff takes precedence when the same modifier is applied.
**** The affected allied heroes can pick up or drop items without breaking invisibility.
**** The invisibility breaks upon {{M|attack point}}, or the abilities' {{M|cast point}}.
*** {{Symbol|bonus t2r}} {{Symbol|Evasion}}
**** The [[evasion]] bonus is independent of the granted invisibility.
***** The evasion proc is determined the attack projectile impact, and uses {{M|pseudo-random distribution}} {{Proctal|{{#var:Moonlight Shadow type1 value1}}}}.
***** [[Evasion#Stacking|Stacks]] diminishingly with other evasion sources.
***** Learning the {{M|talent|t=t2r|x}} does not update the current instance.
